selected_run_id_by_summary: ALL_ACTIVE_NON_TEST (WHERE run_id != 'run_golden_shadow_001' AND run_id NOT LIKE '%test%')
selected_run_id_by_publications: ALL_ACTIVE_NON_TEST (WHERE run_id != 'run_golden_shadow_001' AND run_id NOT LIKE '%test%')
selected_run_id_by_positions: NONE (Statically set to 'N/A (NOT MATERIALIZED)' in categories view)
diagnosis: The discrepancy across views is caused by an architectural gap: while get_summary() and get_publications() query SQLite (filtering out test/golden shadow runs), get_categories() and get_legacy_comparison() were never wired to the database and remained hardcoded to 2026-09-21 research census stubs.
